data.title: 黍 · 阳台种菜也要教你一起做
data.description: 家中阳台菜箱前，黍穿鼠尾草绿亚麻衬衫与米白长裤，把刚摘的小番茄放在金色手心递给你看。她侧身笑着指向结实的枝条，像在教你判断熟没熟；龙尾沿菜箱外侧自然弯过，不碰枝叶。
data.action: 展示掌心小番茄，另一手指着枝条与你分享
data.lighting: 清晨左侧日光，栏杆与枝叶投影，柔和环境反光
data.promptProse: Shu offers a freshly picked cherry tomato on her golden palm beside the balcony planter, smiling sideways and pointing to the fruiting branch. Her sage linen shirt and cream trousers remain clear in the eye-level cowboy view; her dragon tail curves outside the planter without touching foliage. Morning light from the left catches the tomato and rolled cuff, laying rail and leaf shadows across the balcony.
